notes: Groups in Present mode: shuffling no longer moves the slides or ends the lesson, and each shuffle keeps last time's groups apart.
Change groups by hand: drag a name to another group, or click a name and then a group. Make my own starts with empty groups, and Undo or Ctrl Z takes back a move or a shuffle.
The Present timer keeps running after you finish or leave full screen, in the corner of the Planner, and comes back on the slides when you present again.
